At a 22% rate that saves about $264 of federal income tax. Assumed: the gross vehicle weight rating is under 14,000 pounds; the loan is secured by a first lien on the vehicle.

This is an estimate, not tax advice. Check the IRS instructions or ask a tax professional before you file.

assumed_requirements: the gross vehicle weight rating is under 14,000 pounds
the loan is secured by a first lien on the vehicle

phaseout.rule: $200 for each $1,000 (or part of $1,000) of MAGI over the threshold

notes: You can claim it whether you itemize or take the standard deduction (Schedule 1-A Part IV).
You must enter the vehicle identification number (VIN) on the return.
Married filing separately can claim it; the threshold is $100,000 for every status except married filing jointly.
Interest on negative equity rolled in from a trade-in, insurance or a trailer does not count. Service plans, extended warranties, sales tax and vehicle fees financed with the purchase do.
A refinanced loan keeps qualifying up to the balance refinanced if it stays secured by a first lien on the same vehicle.
